final: WITH combo_counts AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS order_reference, o.orderflow AS order_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), shares AS (SELECT order_reference, order_status, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY order_status) AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY order_status) AS average_share FROM combo_counts) SELECT order_reference, order_status, record_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY above_average_share DESC LIMIT 10.
